title: A shared platform connects business users, governed data products, and reusable services across the enterprise
users_and_outcomes: Define the analyst, developer, data-sharing, and AI experiences the platform must support, then link each experience to an accountable business owner.
information_lifecycle: Move source data through documented quality checks, curated models, and approved semantic definitions before making reusable products available.
platform_services: Provide common ingestion, processing, deployment, monitoring, and support services so delivery teams can focus on their data products.
governance_and_placement: Apply access, classification, and audit controls across the platform; select workload locations using security, cost, performance, and operating requirements.
enterprise_ecosystem: Connect the new platform to existing analytics services and operational sources through approved interfaces, ownership agreements, and support boundaries.
